description: This is a PHP source file defining a validation rule class 'ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule' used in the OrangeHRM Performance module. The class validates reviewer rating parameters for performance reviews, ensuring data correctness and validity.

classes.name: ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule
